text: Registrations for the hackathon trial crashed again last night. Firebase free tier hit the read quota at 9pm and everything froze for 40 minutes.
Yeah, 50k reads/day is not going to survive Orion Fest. We will have 800+ people refreshing the schedule.

Decision: we are moving the backend from Firebase to Supabase because the Firebase free tier quota broke during registrations and Supabase gives us real Postgres with no read limits. I'll start the migration this week.
Makes sense. Does that mean the design doc is outdated? It still says MongoDB.
Yes, ignore the MongoDB section, we are on Postgres now. I'll update the doc later.
For payments we decided to use Razorpay instead of Stripe since students pay with UPI and Stripe India onboarding takes weeks.
Heads up: the deploy failed again this Friday. GitHub Actions free minutes ran out at the end of the week, third time now.
Deploys failing on Friday again because the CI runner quota is exhausted. We keep hitting this every Friday.
I switched login to college SSO in PR #142. Note the college SSO certificate expires on 14 March 2027 and login will break unless the IT cell renews it.
Who do we talk to for the certificate renewal?
Mr. Deshpande in the IT cell handles it, he only replies on email: it.deshpande@sahyadri.edu.in
We decided to use OneSignal for push notifications for event reminders.
Update: we are dropping OneSignal and switching to email-only reminders because the OneSignal plan we need costs too much for the club budget.
The payment webhook has no retry logic. If Razorpay retries we might create duplicate registrations and double charge someone. Risk for fest day.
Kabir owns the webhook retry fix, right?
I thought Priya owns the webhook since she wrote the payments module. I am only on the email service now.
Reminder: Supabase free tier pauses the project after 7 days of inactivity. During the December break someone has to ping it or the database goes to sleep.
staging DB password: Orion#Fest2026 please don't share
PR #151 for payment refunds is still open with a failing test. Need to decide whether to merge or drop it before the code freeze.
Is the staging migration 0009 applied on production yet?
We decided to move from weekly releases to biweekly releases so volunteers have time to test.
Image uploads are on Cloudinary free tier, 25 credits a month. Might run out during fest week when everyone uploads photos.
